blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An American soldier who survived the Bataan Death March but later died as a prisoner of war (POW) in the Philippines during World War II has been identified more than eight decades after his death. The Defense POW/MIA Accounting Agency (DPAA), the US agency tasked with accounting for missing military personnel, said […]...
